body.statement: For finite \(\mathcal X\) and binary outcomes, if \(C_x\) denotes the conditional frontier in stratum \(x\), then \(C_P(t)=\min\{\sum_xp_xC_x(t_x):\sum_xp_xt_x=t\}\), and conditional optimizers attaining the minimum glue into one compatible full law.
body.justification: The infimal convolution converts the multi-stratum problem into exact one-dimensional resource allocation.
body.gap: Armwise average-case optimization does not establish that conditional ATE allocations glue under a shared joint-response law.
body.consumer: A prespecified finite NHANES stratification can be analyzed with conditional scalar frontiers and a common dual price.
